answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Every claim climbs the ferrous of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the onyx re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
